title: An Evening with Mark Twain
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy an intimate and entertaining evening with legendary Mark Twain brought to life by renowned impressionist McAvoy Layne during this exclusive small‑group experience at Twain Haven, McAvoy’s home in Incline Village. The evening begins at 5:00 PM with a guided tour of the Twain Gallery, where guests can explore exhibits dedicated to the life and legacy of Samuel Clemens. Guests are encouraged to bring their beverage of choice and relax in a warm, storytelling atmosphere. The highlight of the evening is a live Mark Twain performance by McAvoy Layne, whose 35 years of experience and acclaimed portrayal combine humor, insight, and classic storytelling. Limited to just 2–6 guests, this unique experience offers a personal, cultural, and memorable encounter with one of America’s most beloved literary figures.
